structured_output.what_is_happening: A wave of at least 10 "Effective Accelerationism" / e/acc clone tokens launched within about 15 minutes (pair creation times from 1790370915 to 1790371831), apparently reacting to a post by @beffjezos (GeckoTerminal links status 2103593870189858971). This token is a mid-wave copy at about $28k market cap. It is a directly created PumpSwap pool, not a pump.fun graduation (migrated_unix=0), and 100% of its LP is unlocked. The leading same-name token, CbcyNo7m..., is at $437k market cap with $1.6M in one-hour volume.

narrative.description: e/acc is the movement tied to Beff Jezos (Guillaume Verdon). A new Beff tweet seems to have set off a burst of clone launches.
narrative.why_spreading: A tweet from a well-known crypto/AI figure triggered a burst of rival launches. The attention is split across many clones.

token_connection.why_this_token: Same name and ticker. It has no socials, no website and no DexScreener profile. It is not the earliest token and not the biggest.
token_connection.competing_tokens: CbcyNo7m... ($437k market cap, $1.6M 1h volume, earliest), 45bRFa... ($258k), 6TrwU9... ($145k), plus about 6 more at $20-50k.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN counts 43 bundler wallets, and bundler traders hold 25.6% of top-trader volume. On GeckoTerminal there were 886 buys in 5 minutes against only 52 unique sellers. Liquidity ($35k) is larger than market cap ($28k), which fits a dev-seeded pool with LP they can pull. The same clone template appears across about 10 tokens.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not read X. The 1,301 unique buyers may include some real retail spillover from the main token.

structural_risks: 100% of LP is unlocked in a dev-created PumpSwap pool, so the dev can remove liquidity at any time
Price is already down about 8% over 5 minutes from its high

structured_output.counterargument: The overall e/acc narrative is hot. Low-cap clones sometimes catch spillover buyers who miss the leader, and a $28k market cap needs only small inflows to double. Top-10 holders are spread out (about 15%), and mint and freeze authority are renounced.
unknowns: What the Beff tweet actually says, and whether it endorses any contract address
Who holds the LP and what the dev intends

source_coverage.notes: Time-limited. The X post returned HTTP 402. A search for the contract address returned nothing. I checked live data on the DexScreener API.

structured_output.thesis: This is a non-canonical clone in a wave of e/acc copies. Its LP is fully unlocked, and it shows heavy bundler and bot activity. The leading token takes most of the attention, so this one is more likely to be rugged or abandoned than to double.
